title: The Whole Promise
author: Kestrel Okafor
blurb: Lior Yarrow, a pastry chef whose café is three missed payments from gone, has spent ten years rebuilding a life measured in small safe steps. Then a snowstorm strands two rivals with the best mistake of their twenties — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must risk the whole heart instead of lending pieces before the festival ends.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
